The '''Infinite Seed''' was a piece taken from the [[Infinite Engine]], a self-replicating piece of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Star Forge]] hidden inside [[Darth Revan's complex]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], by an Imperial sent by General [[Kolvin (Human)|Kolvin]] to investigate it. Finding a group of [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]] living inside the complex and sustained only by the Engine, the Imperial slayed [[Azraj-Nug]] and the rest of the Ongree inhabitants. The Seed was turned over by Kolvin to the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]], which later informed its discoverer on the Seed's unique, self-growing properties.<ref>{{TORcite|type=general|The Infinite Machine|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>
